summary: ansible-core uses a flexible release cycle with graduated maintenance across three releases: full bug and security fixes at first, then security and critical fixes, then security fixes only.
questions: How long does an ansible-core version get bug fixes?
What fixes does an older ansible-core release still get?
Is it safe to run an unmaintained ansible-core?

answer_card.title: ansible-core maintenance window
answer_card.answer_md:
ansible-core is maintained across **three** releases:

1. When first released: security and general bug fixes.
2. After the next version ships: security and critical bug fixes.
3. After the one after that: security fixes only.

Older versions can contain unfixed CVEs, so upgrade. Install with `pip` and use the core porting guides when upgrading.
